name: Melchizedek
description: Priest living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine; Salem goes into Shalom, peace, so he is the king of peace, and he was the priest of the Most High God.

note.label: Genesis 14: The War of the Kings and Melchizedek

points: The Lord hath sworn and will not repent, thou art a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek. Christ is the priest forever after this order.

note.label: Psalm 110: Sit Thou at My Right Hand

points: “Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek”: who was our forefather King David prophesying about? Christ.

“Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec”: that’s going into Christ; it’s not talking about us. Brothers saying I don’t want to be a bishop or a deacon, I’m a priest after the order of Melchisedec: where’s your red heifer, your goats? I’m telling you, a Negro will purchase a goat and sheep and kill it in his backyard. Y’all complain about the dead animals in Ohio, allegedly Levi eating cats and dogs; Judah about to get buck wild with this old covenant crap.
